effect.name: GM Hue Shift Tunnel
effect.desc: Wraps the layer around a tunnel and rotates the hue with depth, so the colour cycles as the corridor recedes. Five cross sections: a round bore, a square bore, a hexagonal kaleidoscopic bore, a triangular one, and a flat corridor. Depth scale, travel speed, hue per unit of depth, a global hue rotation, ring shading along the tunnel, a twist that skews the bore with distance, a swirl that rotates the whole wall, saturation and brightness are all separate. The tunnel centre is a layer point, so the whole corridor is welded to the layer.
